title: Senior UI/UX Website Designer (Freelance/Project-Based)
description:
**Words And Cappuccinos** is looking for an experienced **Senior UI/UX Website Designer** for an upcoming healthcare website redesign project.

This is **not a basic website mockup assignment**. We are looking for someone who can take a project from UX planning and wireframing through polished responsive UI design and developer\-ready Figma handoff.

Project Scope

The project involves redesigning the digital experience of a US\-based healthcare organization serving multiple audience groups, including members/caregivers and organizational partners.

The selected designer will be responsible for:

* Reviewing the existing website, project brief and brand materials
* Refining website information architecture and sitemap
* Understanding and mapping key user journeys
* Creating UX wireframes for core page types
* Developing the overall visual direction
* Designing high\-fidelity website screens in Figma
* Creating desktop, tablet and mobile\-responsive layouts
* Designing audience\-specific user experiences and CTAs
* Building reusable UI components and a scalable design system
* Creating navigation, buttons, cards, forms, testimonial modules and other UI states
* Developing interactive prototypes for important user journeys
* Following accessibility\-conscious UX/UI practices
* Organizing Figma files and components professionally
* Preparing developer\-ready design specifications and handoff
* Incorporating consolidated feedback during defined revision rounds

The project documentation anticipates core areas such as Homepage, Why Us, Services, Members \& Caregivers, Partner/Agency pages, About, Contact/Get Help and Trust/Compliance.

Required Skills \& Experience

We are looking for someone with strong experience in:

* UI/UX website design
* Figma
* Information architecture
* User journey mapping
* Wireframing
* Responsive web design
* Design systems and reusable components
* Desktop, tablet and mobile UX
* Conversion\-focused website design
* Accessibility\-conscious web design
* Interactive prototyping
* Developer handoff
* Working with structured client feedback

Experience designing **healthcare, SaaS, B2B, professional services or other complex information\-heavy websites** will be preferred.

The project specifically requires accessible design considerations such as readable typography, adequate contrast, accessible form patterns, clear focus states and logical interaction hierarchy.

Design Style

The desired website experience should feel:

**Modern**  Human **Professional**  Trustworthy **Clear**  Accessible **Conversion\-focused**

The brand direction should be evolved rather than completely reinvented. The website should avoid a generic hospital/insurance look and should balance warmth for members and caregivers with professional credibility for organizational audiences.

Project Duration

Approximately **7–8 working weeks**, subject to client feedback and approvals.

The planned workflow includes discovery, UX/wireframes, visual direction, high\-fidelity UI, responsive design, client refinements and final developer handoff.

Engagement Type

**Freelance / Project\-Based / Remote**

This role is currently focused on **UX/UI design and Figma handoff**. Website development is not part of this particular requirement.

How to Apply

Please send:

* Your UI/UX portfolio
* 2–3 relevant website projects
* Examples of complete Figma projects/design systems, if available
* Healthcare/B2B/SaaS website experience, if any
* Your project\-based quotation
* Your availability for the next 8 weeks
* Estimated time required for a project of this scope

**Important:** Please do not apply with only graphic\-design/social\-media portfolios. We are specifically looking for demonstrated **website UX/UI experience**.

Interested candidates can send their portfolio, quotation and availability.

**Words And Cappuccinos**

Website Content **Design**  Development **Digital Marketing**

Pay: ₹10,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Work from home

You will be involved throughout the complete design process—from understanding product requirements and creating user flows and wireframes to designing high\-fidelity interfaces, interactive prototypes, and developer\-ready designs.

UI/UX Portfolio – Figma / Behance / Dribbble / PDF

Work on a real\-world digital product from day one.

Design interfaces for both Mobile and Web platforms.

Work alongside experienced developers and product teams.

Build production\-level UI/UX experience.

Opportunity to contribute creative ideas to a growing technology product.

Performance\-based growth and long\-term career opportunities.

title: Motion Graphic Designer
description:
**About Atlys**
---------------


Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.


Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.


Atlys is changing that.


We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries**. But we’re still early.

  

**The Role**
------------


We're looking for a **Motion Designer** to own motion and interaction design across the Atlys app and website.


You'll work with Product Designers, PMs and Engineers to make Atlys feel intuitive, responsive and premium.


This is a high\-ownership role. You'll own motion from concept to final QA, making Atlys feel like a product designed to move rather than one with animations added afterward.

  

**The Job**
-----------

* **Bring product experiences to life.** Turn static Figma designs into full interactions, including transitions, micro\-interactions, gestures, and loading, success and error states.
* **Simplify complex flows.** Use motion to make visa applications, status changes and payments easier to understand, starting early in each feature.
* **Own the Atlys Motion Library.** Build reusable patterns, motion principles and haptics guidelines that give Atlys a consistent motion language.
* **Partner with Engineering to ship it right.** Write specs engineers can build, choose the right format (native, CSS, Lottie or video) and keep animations lightweight.
* **Own product storytelling.** Lead motion for product videos, launches and landing pages that show Atlys' value quickly.

  

**The Ideal Candidate**
-----------------------


You’ll likely thrive in this role if you:

* Have 3–5 years of motion or interaction design experience in a tech company or similarly fast\-moving digital product environment.
* Have a strong portfolio of product UI motion (not just marketing or brand animation) that shows how motion improves usability and communicates state.
* Are highly proficient in Figma and at least one motion or prototyping tool (After Effects, Rive, ProtoPie, Jitter), have hands\-on experience with Lottie, and understand web and native (iOS/Android) constraints.
* Can build and maintain a motion system, and document it so designers and engineers actually use it.
* Communicate motion decisions clearly, push back when motion can fundamentally improve the UX, and spot opportunities without waiting to be asked.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*

  

**What you can expect**
-----------------------


Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.


Here’s what you can expect:

* **Competitive compensation and equity** so you participate in the value you help create.
* **Comprehensive health insurance** covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* **A thoughtful leave policy** with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* **Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office**, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* **Learning \& development credits** to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* **Relocation support** to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* **Great tools to do your best work**, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* **An office designed for more than just work**, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.

  

Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.

 *Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

description:
### **About the role**



We are looking for a Junior Product Designer to join our Product team and help shape the everyday experience of Globalli's platform — from onboarding flows to the dashboards our customers rely on to manage a global workforce. You will work closely with product, engineering, and operations stakeholders to turn real user problems into clear, usable interfaces.

You will report directly to our Head of Product.

* Solid understanding of user\-centered design principles, information architecture, and interaction design fundamentals
* Clear communication skills — you can explain your design decisions and take feedback well
* Comfort working async and independently as part of a distributed, remote\-first team
* Curiosity about B2B/SaaS products, payroll, HR tech, or workforce management is a plus, but not required


**We welcome applicants at any stage of their design career — recent graduates, bootcamp grads, and self\-taught designers with a compelling portfolio are all encouraged to apply.**

title: Graphic Designer - Architectural
description:
**This role is for one of our clients**

Company Name: Clear Bracket
Seniority level: Associate level

JobType: full\-time



**Location:** South Delhi


* **Experience:** 1 to 3 years
* **Work Mode:** Work from Office
* **Work Structure:** Five Days Working
* **Preferred Background:** B.Arch or Architecture or Spatial Design or Communication Design


**About the Role**

We are hiring a **Communication Designer** for a leading design\-led architecture practice.  

This role sits at the intersection of **architecture, storytelling, visual communication, and brand consistency**.  

The studio’s work needs to be communicated to different audiences — clients, students, media, design juries, institutions, and collaborators. Each audience reads architecture differently. A client looks for value and trust. A student looks for process. A media platform looks for narrative. A design jury looks for intent, clarity, and rigour.  

That is why this role is best suited for someone who has studied or deeply understands architecture, but may not want to practise core architecture.  



**Why an Architecture Background Helps**  

This is not a typical graphic design role.  

  

You will work with:


* plans, sections, drawings, diagrams, renders, photographs, and project notes
* Architectural concepts, material stories, context, process, and spatial intent
* Project decks, award entries, website features, presentations, and design narratives
  


 To do this well, you need to understand what architects are trying to say before turning it into clear visual communication.  

A B.Arch background is valuable because the role requires someone who can read design intent, not just arrange text and images.


**What You Will Do**


* Create visual communication assets for presentations, website, social media, print, events, and digital platforms
* Support project features, award entries, pitch decks, and design presentations
* Translate architectural ideas into clear visual formats
* Work with principals and design teams to understand project intent
* Develop layouts using strong grid, typography, image treatment, and hierarchy
* Help maintain consistency across the studio’s communication material
* Support communication for talks, school presentations, project launches, and media features
* Work with drawings, renders, site images, process notes, and project stories


**What We Are Looking For**  

You may be a strong fit if you:


* Have a B.Arch or architecture / spatial design background
* Enjoy communication more than conventional architectural practice
* Can understand architectural drawings and design process
* Have strong visual layout and typography sense
* Are comfortable working with both images and text
* Are detail\-oriented and patient with refinement
* Can take feedback from senior design leaders
* Are curious about how architecture is made, presented, and remembered


**Skills Required**


* Visual Communication
* Layout Design
* Typography
* Image Editing
* Presentation Design
* Adobe Illustrator
* Adobe InDesign
* Adobe Photoshop
* AutoCAD
* SketchUp
* Microsoft Office


**Good to Have**


* Writing ability
* Architectural journalism interest
* Award entry experience
* Social media content experience
* Videography / editing skills
* Basic motion graphics
* Familiarity with architectural publications or design media

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans.
